description: What irexplorer accepts as a user program (spec #51, ticket #58). The server (tests/test_user_programs_api.py) and the browser (scripts/check_user_programs.mjs) check every case, so the two apply the same rules. A source is a string, or a list of strings and [text, count] repeats joined in order. A case either is accepted, as the safe file name and normalised source sent to the compiler service, or is refused with the reason and the message the browser shows as is.
